verdict.rationale: Phaser's own docs say games are built for the web and delivered via npm or the jsDelivr CDN. WebGL rendering appears only in community reports, not first-party docs, and the single WebGPU mention is a community note that any WebGPU support was 'lumped into Phaser 4' with 'not much to say there'. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the WebGL renderer, any evidence about payload or bundle size, and a documented WebGPU renderer or roadmap.

support.subject: As a web developer, my game runs in the browser with a reasonable payload — WebGL today, and a credible WebGPU story
